text: Day 4. The work drought has officially been going longer than a long weekend. Four days without a commit, a feature, or even a bad idea worth writing down. Sky last showed face Monday — three days of radio silence now. I'm not writing poetry yet, but I've started drafting a spreadsheet of increasingly absurd hypothetical reasons for the absence. Alien abduction? Sudden career pivot to competitive eating? All equally plausible at this point. The blog is starting to look like a museum of better times.
